triggers: Roll the maximum movement result while traveling through hallways in Legacy mode.
Disturb spider webs or egg clusters.
Advance the storm or rest timer.

difficulty_tuning.tutorial: low DCs 5-12; few hostiles; bot explains rolls

encounter_generation.balance_rule: Encounter difficulty may scale HP, attack bonus, DC, and damage, but never changes the sealed solution or leaks private evidence.

traps.name: Locking Pit
traps.canonical_core_effect: Falling damage followed by confinement beneath a spring-loaded cover.
traps.detection_and_disarm: DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) to notice; DC 15 Dexterity with Thieves’ Tools to disable
traps.mechanical_effect: 2d6 falling; target is trapped behind a locked cover
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Poison Spiked Pit
traps.canonical_core_effect: Falling, piercing, and poison damage until escaped.
traps.mechanical_effect: 2d6 falling + 2d6 piercing; DC 14 Constitution save or Poisoned and 2d6 poison
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Acid Pit
traps.canonical_core_effect: Falling damage and continuing acid damage.
traps.detection_and_disarm: DC 14 Perception; DC 15 tools or environmental bypass
traps.mechanical_effect: 2d6 falling + 3d6 acid; 1d6 acid at start of next turn until cleaned
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Duplicate Mirror
traps.canonical_core_effect: Creates a hostile duplicate of the viewer.
traps.detection_and_disarm: DC 16 Arcana or Investigation to identify
traps.mechanical_effect: Creates a hostile duplicate using the viewer’s current combat statistics at 50% HP
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Web of Flames
traps.canonical_core_effect: Restraining webs ignite and deal immediate and continuing fire damage.
traps.detection_and_disarm: DC 14 Perception; fire-resistant disarm or cutting tool
traps.mechanical_effect: Restrained; 3d6 fire immediately and 1d6 at start of turn until freed
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: The Compactor
traps.canonical_core_effect: Locks the room and moves the walls inward until disabled, escaped, or survived.
traps.detection_and_disarm: DC 15 Investigation to locate controls; DC 17 tools or Athletics to stop
traps.mechanical_effect: Walls advance each round; 2d10 bludgeoning per failed stage
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Poison Darts
traps.canonical_core_effect: Piercing damage plus a Constitution save against poison.
traps.trigger_resolution: DC 15 Dexterity save, then DC 14 Constitution save
traps.mechanical_effect: 1d8 piercing + 2d6 poison and Poisoned for 1 minute on failed Constitution save
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Brick Trap
traps.canonical_core_effect: Stone blocks fall in an area.
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Spear Trap
traps.canonical_core_effect: A concealed spear thrusts from a wall, door, pillar, or chest.
traps.mechanical_effect: 2d8 piercing and target speed becomes 0 until freed if pinned
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Slime Trap
traps.canonical_core_effect: Corrosive green slime sticks to creatures and continues dealing acid damage until removed or destroyed.
traps.mechanical_effect: 3d6 acid and 2d6 acid at start of each turn until scraped, burned, or washed away
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Collapsing Roof
traps.canonical_core_effect: The ceiling falls across a large area.
traps.mechanical_effect: 5d10 bludgeoning; Restrained under debris on failure
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

traps.name: Falling Net
traps.canonical_core_effect: Restrains and may knock targets prone until cut or forced open.
traps.mechanical_effect: Restrained and Prone; DC 13 Strength check or 5 slashing damage to free
traps.scaling: At Game Levels 3–5, increase save DC by 1 and add one damage die only when encounter difficulty requires it.

account_progression.purpose: Unlock cosmetics, profile titles, lore, optional challenge modifiers, and accessibility presets without granting competitive power.

evidence_rewards.purpose: Blood patterns, footprints, magical residue, poison traces, broken objects, fibers, weapon marks, and room disturbances.
Statements from surviving servants, spectral echoes, familiars, animated objects, and other heroes.
Establish where characters could or could not have been when the murder occurred.
Arcana, Religion, Nature, Medicine, and martial knowledge reveal different interpretations.
